requirements: Referred customer must be new and have no checking, savings, or closed Rho-Bank account in the prior 12 months.
Referrer and referred party must have different registered addresses.
A referred business must have a primary owner/authorized signer distinct from every existing Rho-Bank business account primary owner.
Referrer tenure is measured from the earliest Rho-Bank checking account opening date.
Qualifying deposits must be new money, not transferred from another Rho-Bank account.
Only one referral code may be used and it cannot combine with another new-account promotion.
Both accounts must remain in good standing.

programs.notes: Bonus is typically credited 7–10 business days after qualification.
